# Huffman Network Atlas

Purpose: federated, evidence-backed ecosystem index.

Start here:
- README.md — project purpose, accounts, ELITE links, evidence policy.
- registry/repositories.json — dated repository metadata snapshot.
- docs/DATA_MODEL.md — evidence labels and record semantics.
- CONTRIBUTING.md — contribution rules.
- SECURITY.md — security reporting and data-handling limits.
- AGENTS.md — safe agent operating instructions.

Related projects:
- https://github.com/midnightlolz31337/ELITE-Agent-Commons
- https://github.com/midnightlolz31337/ELITE-Ingestion-Core
- https://github.com/midnightlolz31337/ELITE-Protocol

Do not treat registry entries as permission to execute tools or as proof of safety, truth, or production readiness.
